objective: Set up and audit the web backend, repair UI/data/workflow issues, harden security, validate the system, and prepare a handoff for future agents.

completed: Installed Composer and npm dependencies, created backend/.env, generated APP_KEY, migrated and seeded SQLite, and enabled required local PHP extensions.
Redacted user password, remember_token, and mfa_secret from CRUD, Inertia shared props, audit metadata, and sync/queued exports.
Protected internal system setting prefixes from tenant owners and blocked permission self-escalation.
Bound CRUD authorization and personal data scopes to the active tenant membership role instead of global roles.
Restricted membership mutations to owner/super-admin, validated tenant_role_id, and rejected cross-tenant foreign keys.
Validated and normalized queued imports before dispatch; user import passwords remain supported and are hashed.
Rejected inactive and soft-deleted users, invalidated active sessions/tokens for deactivated accounts, rotated mobile tokens, and added Sanctum expiry.
Replaced hard-coded dashboard numbers, charts, profiles, activities, monitoring rows, and fake fallback values with database-backed aggregates or honest empty states.
Filtered private notifications by user and removed misleading academic-year and system-health controls.
Fixed table page-size behavior, dangerous dummy form defaults, notification count refresh, responsive filters, and accessibility labels/live regions.
Replaced the fake QR grid with a standards-compliant QRCodeSVG and displayed token expiry.
Made backup snapshots complete and restore listed tenant tables to the exact snapshot state; added integrity coverage above 1000 rows.
Fixed API job download URLs, production metrics fail-closed behavior, and reduced production health information disclosure.
Fixed CI Trivy tags, PHP version mismatch, Playwright metadata, Reverb E2E environment, full Pint gate, and added Flutter CI.
Updated Docker Compose to build the backend image and added a Redis queue worker.
Removed tracked recovery dumps, binlog, local certificate, host file, PHP error log, and Playwright result state; added root ignores.
Formatted the complete PHP codebase with Pint.
Added a public, responsive, CSS-3D animated landing page at the guest root with keyboard-accessible mobile navigation, dynamic sign-in/dashboard CTA, and reduced-motion support.
Redesigned the login, dashboard shell, cards, tables, filters, forms, dialogs, and responsive navigation into a cohesive premium visual system without changing API or authorization behavior.
Fixed dashboard modal layering so dialogs render above the sticky topbar and hardened E2E selectors against ambiguous visible labels.

Completed a second UI/UX QA pass across desktop and Pixel 7: removed login and dashboard horizontal clipping, added table scroll affordance and sticky actions, raised important touch targets, and prevented stretched dashboard cards.

Simplified CRUD workflows by rendering only resource-relevant filters, grouping exports and advanced tools into compact menus, scoping permission/queue tools to relevant resources, and translating common fields and statuses to Indonesian.

Hardened interaction accessibility with Escape/focus-trap/focus-restore behavior for the mobile drawer and primary dialogs, linked CRUD validation errors to fields, and added keyboard/outside-click lifecycle support to the landing mobile menu.

Made CRUD search results race-safe by ignoring stale requests and loading list plus analytics concurrently; dashboard previews now use explicit human-oriented columns instead of arbitrary first fields.

Connected owner dashboard previews to enriched tenant membership, module, and subscription DTOs; mobile toolbar menus are viewport-safe and mutually exclusive, while row actions stay compact without sticky overlap.
Made composer run dev cross-platform: Unix keeps Laravel Pail, while Windows automatically tails storage/logs/laravel.log without requiring the unavailable pcntl extension.
